queue.title: Ibyifuzo byo kuvanaho amakuru
queue.anonymous_by_design: Ubona gusa nomero y'icyifuzo n'igihe imaze. Ufata icyemezo utamenye uwo ari we, kandi ni ku bushake.
queue.lead: Ibyifuzo biri mu Itegeko N° 058/2021. Kwanga bisaba impamvu zanditse umuturage azabona. Gusiba ntibisubirwaho.

refusal.REFUSED_ACTIVE_APPLICATION: Hari ubusabe bukiri buzima. Amakuru agomba kubikwa kugeza burangiye.

decline.title: Kwanga iki cyifuzo
decline.ground_required: Tanga impamvu ishingiye ku mategeko. Kwanga bidafite impamvu byangwa na sisitemu.

withdraw.title: Kwikura mu busabe
withdraw.irreversible: Kwikura ntibisubirwaho. Ushobora kongera gusaba ubutaha.

outcome.NOT_APPLICABLE: Ubu busabe bwamaze kufatirwa icyemezo cya nyuma, ntibushobora kuvanwaho.

execute.title: Gusiba amakuru y'uyu muntu?
execute.body: Ibi bikora isiba rigenzurwa ry'umukandida uri inyuma y'iki cyifuzo.

errors.groundsRequired: Impamvu zanditse zirakenewe kugira ngo wange.
